meta.name: daily-memory
meta.description: Use when you completed any task and need to log what was done with timestamps for future audit/review.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录已完成任务并添加时间戳，方便日后审计回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要记录任务完成情况并保留时间戳用于回顾
copy.tagline_en: Log completed tasks with timestamps for future audit and review
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to record completed tasks with timestamps for later review

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你完成一项任务时，自动将任务记录到当天的日志文件中，包含时间戳和可选标签。
howto.when: 当你完成任何任务并需要记录时，可以要求 Claude 记录。

say.text: 记录我刚刚完成了代码审查。
say.note: Claude 会添加一条带时间戳的日志。

say.text: 记录今天的工作：修复了登录 bug，标签：bug, urgent。
say.note: Claude 会添加带标签的日志。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will log completed tasks to a daily file with timestamps and optional tags.
howto.when_en: When you finish any task and need to log it, you can ask Claude to record it.

say_en.text: Log that I just finished code review.
say_en.note: Claude will add a timestamped entry.

say_en.text: Log today's work: fixed login bug, tags: bug, urgent.
say_en.note: Claude will add a tagged entry.
